params.name: state
params.description:
Filter by post state

 Available options: 

 `all`, `scheduled`, `scheduled_approved`, `scheduled_pending`, `scheduled_declined`, `scheduled_reauth`, `scheduled_locked`, `published`, `published_posted`, `published_deleted`, `published_hidden`, `draft`, `draft_dated`, `draft_undated`, `draft_private`, `draft_public`, `failed`, `recycling`, `recycling_active`, `recycling_paused`, `recycling_expired`, `recycling_failed`, `recycling_pending`, `recycling_declined`, `recycling_reauth`, `recycling_locked`, `recurring`

params.name: from
params.description:
Filter posts scheduled/published after this date 

- Example: 2025-05-15 

 Required if `to` is provided

params.name: to
params.description:
Filter posts scheduled/published before this date 

- Example: 2025-05-15 

 Required if `from` is provided

params.name: account_ids
params.description: Filter posts by multiple account IDs

params.name: query
params.description: Search query to filter posts by content

params.name: postType
params.description:
Filter by post type 

 Available options: 

 `status`, `link`, `photo`, `gif`, `video`, `reel`, `story`, `short`, `poll`, `document`, `carousel`, `article`

params.name: member_id
params.description: Filter posts by team member ID

items.docs: Retrieves a list of posts based on the specified filters.

params.name: post_ids
params.description: Array of post IDs to delete. Can include both MongoDB ObjectIDs and PostgreSQL IDs.

items.docs: Deletes one or multiple posts from the workspace specifying exact post IDs. Authorization rules apply to ensure users can only delete posts they have permission to delete.
Schedule one or more posts for publishing. Supports immediate publishing, scheduled publishing, auto-scheduling, recurring posts, and more.
Creates a new social media post. Can be scheduled for immediate publishing, future publishing, or saved as a draft.

params.name: id
params.description: ID of the post to update

items.docs: Updates an existing post. The behavior differs depending on whether the post is already published or not.
